title: atomic-kms-key-promotion-with-grace-period-rollback-hooks
author: Elena Ruiz
description: Motivation: On private deployments customers run HSM-backed KMS with periodic key rotations. Past rotations that involved immediate primary key swaps caused brief failures during leader election and sealed-secrets unseal handoffs in air-gapped clusters. This PR implements an "atomic key promotion" flow plus a configurable grace period and automated rollback hooks to ensure safe cutover without downtime.
summary: Add atomic KMS key promotion orchestration, Helm chart hooks for staged promotion, Terraform module updates for key metadata, and rollback hooks that revert promotion state and re-issue lightweight certificates when cutover fails.

d2c4e7a: helm: add pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks for key promotion job
b6f9a11: terraform: extend redwood_kms_key resource with 'promotion_window' and 'fallback_key'
e34d2b0: installer: implement rollback hooks and safe symlink rotation for keystore
f7c2b8e: docs: document promotion lifecycle and emergency rollback steps
a9e1c44: tests: integration test for promotion graceful-fail and rollback path
review_conversation: Avery Chen (reviewer): Can you clarify the invariants the controller expects from the HSM when promoting? If the HSM can return transient errors we should not mark promotion complete.

Elena Ruiz (author): The controller treats HSM transient errors as retryable for the duration of the promotion_window. Only persistent failures (>= 3 consecutive failures over promotion_window) trigger the rollback hook. I added comments and unit tests around retry behavior.

Priya Natarajan (reviewer): Helm hooks look good but make sure the promote-posthook is idempotent in case the job is retried by Tiller or Helm3. Also include a final 'verify-pp' probe before switching primary symlink.
Elena Ruiz (author): Updated promote-posthook to use a compare-and-swap flag stored in a Kubernetes annotation; added verify-pp probe script and tests.
design_notes: Design highlights: 1) Introduce a small KMSPromotion CRD that records desired_key, fallback_key, state, and promotion_window. 2) Controller coordinates: pre-validate HSM key status, run promote job as Helm pre-upgrade hook, wait for verification, atomically swap primary keystore symlink, mark promotion complete. 3) On failure, controller triggers a rollback hook that restores prior symlink, re-issues short-lived certificates for workloads that request re-enrollment, and emits detailed audit events. 4) Terraform exposes promotion_window and fallback_key to ops teams to set conservative defaults for on-prem clusters.
backwards_compatibility: Defaults preserve prior behavior: if promotion_enabled is not set, nothing changes. The CRD is optional and controller is no-op until a KMSPromotion resource is applied.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Canary in staging with one dedicated region (72h observation). Phase 2: Opt-in customers via Terraform flag 'promotion_enabled'. Phase 3: Gradual enablement with telemetry-based rollback thresholds. Ops runbook included in docs.
testing: Added integration e2e that simulates HSM transient failures, verifies promotion_window semantics, and asserts rollback hooks restore cluster to healthy state. Manual verification script included (scripts/tools/promote-check.sh).
upgrade_notes: When upgrading installer: new controller will be installed side-by-side. Operators should create KMSPromotion resources only after ensuring node agents are at vX+1. Terraform module bump required for promotion flags. No forced schema migrations.
rollback_instructions: If a promotion fails in production the controller will automatically invoke rollback; manual rollback steps: 1) kubectl annotate kms-promotion <name> --override=rollback=true 2) run ./scripts/tools/promote-check.sh --force-rollback 3) monitor logs (controller logs include 'rollback-complete' event)
release_notes:
- Added atomic KMS key promotion orchestration and controller
- Helm hooks to coordinate pre/post promotion jobs
- Terraform variables to configure promotion window and fallback keys
- Automatic rollback hooks and documented runbook for on-prem clusters
notes: This PR originated from a support case (SUP-8301) where a customer experienced a failed HSM promotion that took several minutes of manual intervention. The automation reduces human error and latency during cutover.
